music.mood: calm, warm, gentle adventure, a little jazzy

text.win: The Churn Beetle is balanced out. Every freelancer gets paid, and they stay past invoice number one.
text.lose: The books didn't balance this time. Take a breath at the inn and try again.
text.credits: With thanks to the Ledgerly team, from PostHog

game.intro: Freelancers are leaving Ledgerly after their first invoice, and nobody can see why.

town.name: Ledger Town
town.inn_line: Invoices can wait. Rest up, the tea is on the house.

regions.name: Bank Link Woods
regions.blurb: Many enter. Few connect their bank.

regions.name: Compliance Dunes
regions.blurb: Every step here needs three approvals.

party.name: Mira
party.sprite_prompt: a calm product analyst with glasses and a green cardigan

party.name: Theo
party.sprite_prompt: a friendly customer success rep with a headset and a yellow sweater

npcs.name: Freelancer
npcs.line: I got stuck connecting my bank and just... gave up. Sorry!
npcs.sprite_prompt: a freelance designer with a laptop bag and a beanie

npcs.name: Compliance
npcs.line: Every rollout goes to everyone at once. That makes me nervous.
npcs.sprite_prompt: a compliance officer in a grey suit holding a stamp

npcs.name: Head of PM
npcs.line: They send one invoice and leave. I would love to know why.
npcs.sprite_prompt: a head of product with a notebook and a green scarf

enemies.name: Signup Snag
enemies.pain: Tiny form bugs that add up.
enemies.sprite_prompt: a small green bug tangled in a paper form

enemies.name: Bank Link Bug
enemies.sprite_prompt: a quick green fly holding a broken chain link

enemies.name: Big Bang
enemies.pain: Ship to everyone or no one.
enemies.sprite_prompt: a round navy beetle with a lit fuse on its back

enemies.name: Audit Shell
enemies.pain: Every change waits on a review.
enemies.sprite_prompt: an armoured grey tortoise with a stamp-shaped shell

enemies.name: Invoice Fog
enemies.pain: Why do they leave after invoice #1?
enemies.sprite_prompt: a floating fog ghost with question-mark eyes

boss.name: The Churn Beetle
boss.taunt: One invoice and they're gone. Heh.
boss.phase2: You'll never find out why they left!
boss.sprite_prompt: a giant dark green beetle with a spinning revolving-door shell

product_lines.product_analytics: Find the step where freelancers bail
product_lines.surveys: Ask churners why, in their words
product_lines.feature_flags: Roll out gradually, keep compliance calm
